title: Isovalent molecules
hints: Compare valence electrons and total electrons separately.
O and S are in the same group.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\ce{H2O}$ and $\ce{H2S}$ both have eight valence electrons. Sulfur has more core electrons.
statement:
Which pair has the same total valence-electron count but different total electron counts?

[_]{a}

explanations: Both have two H valence electrons plus six from the central atom.
Both have eight valence electrons but also the same total count of ten.
